title: Can not pair Bluejay to phone
symptom: User cannot get the Bluejay watch or phone to read anything from the Dexcom. The phone and watch are communicating with each other but no readings show up on the watch.
cause: The thread indicates that native mode must be used for the BlueJay collector to work. Also, if using a Dexcom receiver, the phone collector must be disabled and the BlueJay must use the phone slot.
fix: Enable native mode and configure the BlueJay as collector: Settings > Smart Watch Features > BlueJay Watch, enable 'Run Collector'. If using a Dexcom receiver, disable 'Run Phone Collector' and enable 'BlueJay uses Phone Slot' in BlueJay Advanced Settings.
evidence_quote: you need to be using native mode for it to work. Get a native mode session working with your phone and when you are confident that is okay then enable the BlueJay as collector.
